applies_to: YORK YMAE air-to-water modular heat pumps with inverter compressors in the two-pipe (heating or cooling) version.
summary: This is the BAS points list for the two-pipe YMAE, which heats or cools (not both at once). It gives BACnet objects next to N2 and Modbus addresses: on/off and mode commands, entering and leaving water setpoints, control settings, chiller-level status and temperatures, and module-level circuit values and bit-coded fault words. Module data is read one module at a time through AV 8. The four-pipe YMAE has its own list.
notes: Access comes from the Modbus function code column: points written with function 06 are marked writable, function 03 points read-only. BV 5 Fault has no function code and is marked read-only.
The sheet does not name the BACnet interface or transport; its notes describe the unit's Modbus RTU link (9600 baud, 8-N-1) with the BAS as leader.
Writable setpoint ranges (IP units) are in the descriptions; SI ranges are in the sheet.

All MV enums are printed in the points table and the sheet has no add-1 note. They are shown as printed, from 0. BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the device may report the printed number + 1; confirm by discovery (read the state text).
The DO17-32 row's short name is printed as DO17-33; it is kept as printed.

integration.summary: Enable BAS start/stop and mode at the HMI (MV 6 and MV 5 show the selection), then switch the unit with MV 1 and pick the mode with MV 2. Write the leaving (or entering) water setpoints for cooling and heating, and read BV 3 for actual on/off, chiller loading, the chiller leaving water temperature, BV 5 and the unit fault words.

minimum_points.name: CHILLER ON|OFF CONTROL SELECTION
minimum_points.why: On/off source; must include BAS (set at HMI)

integration.enable: BAS start/stop and operating-mode control are enabled at the HMI. MV 6 (on/off source: HMI, Remote, HMI+BAS) and MV 5 (mode source: HMI, Remote, HMI+BAS, BAS) show the selection and are read-only over the network.
setup: The sheet's notes describe the microboard's Modbus RTU link: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit; the BAS is the leader and module 1's microboard the follower. BAS addresses are set at the HMI.
MV 3 and MV 4 select whether cooling and heating control on entering or leaving water temperature; write the matching setpoints (AV 1/AV 2 or AV 3/AV 4).
gotchas: MV 1 only commands on/off; read the real state from BV 3.
A BAS setpoint can be outside the unit's default range; read the setpoints back from the unit after writing.
Data defaults to the leader module (No. 1). Write AV 8 to view another module's values; per-module AVs then show that module.

points.name: FAULT STATUS 1
points.states: Bit 0=Unit entering water temperature sensor fault, Bit 1=Ambient temperature sensor fault, Bit 2=Circuit 1 coil temperature sensor fault, Bit 3=Circuit 2 coil temperature sensor fault, Bit 4=Unit leaving water temperature sensor fault, Bit 5=Chiller leaving water temperature sensor fault, Bit 6=Circuit 1 accumulator inlet temperature sensor fault, Bit 7=Circuit 2 accumulator inlet temperature sensor fault, Bit 8=Circuit 1 compressor 1 discharge port temperature sensor fault, Bit 9=Circuit 1 economizer entering temperature sensor fault, Bit 10=Circuit 2 compressor 1 discharge port temperature sensor fault, Bit 11=Circuit 2 economizer entering temperature sensor fault, Bit 12=Circuit 1 economizer leaving temperature sensor fault, Bit 13=Circuit 2 economizer leaving temperature sensor fault, Bit 15=R454B leakage sensor Fault (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 2
points.states: Bit 3=Circuit 1 low pressure transducer fault, Bit 4=Circuit 2 low pressure transducer fault, Bit 5=Circuit 1 high pressure transducer fault, Bit 6=Circuit 2 high pressure transducer fault (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 3
points.states: Bit 7=External interlock fault, Bit 8=Power fault, Bit 11=Unit Water flow fault (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 5
points.states: Bit 0=Communication failure (Follower unit with leader), Bit 1=Communication failure (BAS), Bit 2=Time limit protection, Bit 3=Low ambient temperature in cooling, Bit 4=High ambient temperature in heating, Bit 5=Chiller low leaving temperature in cooling, Bit 6=Chiller high leaving temperature in heating, Bit 10=Unit low leaving temperature in cooling, Bit 12=Unit high leaving temperature in heating, Bit 14=Unit low leaving temperature in heatinging (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 6
points.states: Bit 0=Circuit 1 compressor 1 high discharge port temperature, Bit 2=Circuit 2 compressor 1 high discharge port temperature, Bit 8=Circuit 1 brazed plate heat exchanger anti-freeze protect, Bit 9=Circuit 2 brazed plate heat exchanger anti-freeze protect, Bit 14=Circuit 1 four way valve action failure, Bit 15=Circuit 2 four way valve action failure (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 7
points.states: Bit 0=Unit Dial Switch setting error, Bit 1=Communication failure (unit with circuit 1 driver), Bit 2=Communication failure (unit with circuit 1 fan), Bit 3=Communication failure (unit with circuit 2 fan), Bit 4=Communication failure (unit with circuit 2 driver), Bit 5=Circuit 1 driver fault or inverter compressor fault, Bit 6=Circuit 2 driver fault or inverter compressor fault, Bit 7=Circuit 1 fan driver fault, Bit 8=Circuit 2 fan driver fault, Bit 11=Circuit 1 VSD heat dissipation alarm, Bit 12=Circuit 2 VSD heat dissipation alarm (1=fault)

points.name: FAULT STATUS 8
points.states: Bit 2=Circuit 1 High pressure alarm, Bit 3=Circuit 2 High pressure alarm, Bit 4=Circuit 1 Low discharge pressure alarm, Bit 5=Circuit 2 Low discharge pressure alarm, Bit 6=Circuit 1 Low pressure alarm, Bit 7=Circuit 2 Low pressure alarm, Bit 8=Water filter cleaning reminde, Bit 9=VSD cleaning reminder, Bit 10=Refrigerant leakage alarm (R454B) (1=fault)
